definitions.gloss: opening; the first part of something
definitions.explanation: The very beginning of a piece of writing, a speech, a song, or a race — the part that sets the tone for what follows. It is nearly always used with an evaluation attached: a good {出|で}だし or a bad one.

examples.english: It's off to a good start.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出|で}だし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だ。
examples.english: This novel has a striking opening.

examples.japanese: {出|で}だし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦つまずいた→つまずく：06970_tsumazuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: He stumbled at the start, but got his position back in the second half.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out) plus だし, literally "the coming-out part."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|で}だし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ: to get off to a strong start
- {出|で}だし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦つまずく→つまずく：06970_tsumazuku⟧: to stumble at the start
- {出|で}だし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一行|いちぎょう}: the opening line
- {出|で}だし⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧: to go all out from the start

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧: the opening — more formal, and used mainly of texts, speeches, and meetings
- ⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧: start — the moment of setting off, rather than the opening stretch
- ⟦{書|か}き{出|だ}し→書き出し：19293_kakidashi⟧: opening lines — specifically the first words of a piece of writing
